name: Recovery icon
description: Trait icon for Scab: its sample, `ss.sample.recovery`, on the trait's tile. A trait is a stat, with nothing on the field to match it to, so since the level-up became a choice of which sample fills a syringe the slot shows the sample the trait was taken as, and the tray, the level-up card and the pause sheet agree on what it is. Composed through `use`, so redrawing the sample redraws the slot. The tile keeps its colour. (The weapons keep their projectiles: a weapon's slot has to match what it throws.)
